titulo: Polar concreta e energia positiva na mesma Fock; peso finito não vácuo
resultado: On the same Fock and Weyl/vacuum pair, the positive exponential lift G is self-adjoint and S=JG. The maximal antilinear adjoint and the genuine two-application domain identify Delta=G squared=S-dagger S. Independent root reconstruction covers the bounded tensor/Gamma infrastructure and concrete polar factor. Positive energy is now a theorem for the same Fock: the actual orbital contraction is lifted sectorwise and analyticity extends from the total exponential family by uniform coefficient bounds. Its real boundary is the original Gamma(U1). No Fock analyticity premise is imported. The dual weight on the actual Fock regular core is faithful. A concrete averaged element has quadratic weight exactly one, and the finite-weight ideal is strongly dense. The full scalar finite-weight left ideal and dual invariance have also been constructed. A typed nonzero witness rules out using this invariant weight itself as the exp(-s)-scaled trace; the distinct perturbed trace remains open.
defeito: BW/KMS, Γ_no_fixed geral, traço escalado e objetos globais/matéria ainda pendentes.
proximo_passo: Identificar fluxo modular com boost; construir Γ_no_fixed e traço da mesma Fock; conferir main integral.
